usageNotes: Returns the active Corosync totem protocol settings for the cluster, including transport, crypto cipher/hash, token/join/consensus timers, and interface bindings. Useful when diagnosing cluster communication problems or verifying that totem parameters match expectations after a config change. Requires Sys.Audit on / — a read-only API token with that privilege is sufficient.
tips: Totem settings are written to /etc/pve/corosync.conf — this endpoint reflects what Corosync is currently configured with, not necessarily what is live in memory if the daemon has not reloaded.

Key fields to watch: 'token' (ms before a node is declared dead, default 3000), 'crypto_cipher' and 'crypto_hash' (should be non-none in production clusters), and 'transport' (udpu for unicast, knet for Proxmox 7.1+).
If the returned object is empty or missing expected keys, the cluster config may not yet be fully initialized — confirm with get_cluster_status first.
